issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify that SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) should return a double (to provide double precision for financial calculations), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected method signature and numeric precision and will cause compilation/signature mismatches if tests or instructions expect a double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the calculateTotalPrice method signature and implementation consistent with the specification: change its return type to double and compute the total using double precision (e.g., use a double accumulator and return a double). Alternatively, if integer prices are intended, update the problem statement and UML to specify an int return type and remove references to double precision.
